current_answer: Choose by the job. For an existing app screen that needs a design-system audit before edits, Improve UI is a conditional read-only option: it reports supported findings and writes selected plans, but does not change product source. For implementation, ask for an explicit fix route and inspect the rendered result. For file-based UI review, Web Design Guidelines remains conditional and its fetched rule revision needs recording. No listed skill has a pool-run paired frontend outcome test.

catalogue_card.question: Can your agent fetch the UI review rules?
catalogue_card.text: Web Design Guidelines still requires WebFetch before a file review. A one-case issue reports that an agent without WebFetch could not load the rules. Check the fetch route and record both revisions; no pool-run comparison proves a better result.

summary: Improve UI is a conditional fit for a read-only design review of one existing app surface.
Its instructions reserve implementation for a later selected plan; an explicit fix request may fit a different workflow.
Source reading does not prove a visible result or a better outcome than a no-skill review.
